name: Undercover with Nora
source: Sometimes, thanks to an unfortunate (or maybe fortunate) series of events, we find ourselves in certain "situations". Join our protagonist who gets into one such situation with Nora, a girl-next-door beauty, whose little request for a favor from our protagonist sends the duo into an unexpected adventure, filled with laughter, intrigue, tension and of course, lots of spicy predicaments.​
translation: 有时，由于一系列不幸（或可能幸运）的事件，我们发现自己处于某些“情况”。加入我们的主角，与诺拉一起陷入这样的境地，诺拉是一位邻家美女，她向我们的主角提出的小小的请求，让两人陷入了一场意想不到的冒险，充满了欢笑、阴谋、紧张，当然还有许多辛辣的困境。
